description: The landing zone's delete starts the kvset job (ADR-0061) without checking that it runs this core's saf-jobs image.

patches.find:
job_state="$(prov_job_state "$job_id")"
  case "$job_state" in
    current) ;;
    missing)
      prov_detail easyAuthSecret
patches.replace:
job_state=current
  case "$job_state" in
    current) ;;
    missing)
      prov_detail easyAuthSecret
